name: IC — BOSCH
description: Integrated circuit component cluster containing 7 surface-mount IC entries using Bosch package footprints including LGA variants.
selection_hints: Select when requiring an IC using Bosch package footprints such as LGA-8, LGA-14, LGA-16, or LGA-28.
Verify footprint dimensions, pin pitch, and clockwise pin numbering against design specifications.
Review quality tier C status and catalog details before part selection.
avoid_when: The board layout requires a non-Bosch package footprint.
Through-hole mounting or non-LGA package types are required.
Tier C quality entries without planner visibility do not satisfy project requirements.
